description: Uploads a local audio file (path, or base64 content) and renders it with a Mastering preset on the server (POST /mastering/jobs): the same engine as the Jam Jam web tool. Pass EXACTLY ONE of `preset` (a preset id from jj_list_mastering_presets, or builtin:<id>) and `settings` (inline settings, see jj_create_mastering_preset). The result is a 48 kHz WAV (`format` wav-pcm16 by default, wav-pcm24, or wav-f32). Asynchronous: by default this returns at once with the job, then follow it with jj_mastering_get_job; pass maxWaitMs to wait, and a render that finishes in time is downloaded in the same call (`file`). Open to any account (3 renders per ISO week for a free account, 429 quota-exhausted beyond; unlimited for Premium) and needs the mastering:write scope. Limits: a file of at most 200 MB and 10 minutes, one or two channels; one render runs and three wait per account. The render consumes the Mastering render counter (shared with the Jam Jam app), counted at submission; a failed or cancelled render is refunded. Results are kept 24 hours. Only call it when the user asked to master that file.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded audio content. Mutually exclusive with path. Requires "filename".

filename.description: File name (with extension). Required with contentBase64; defaults to the basename of "path".

maxWaitMs.description: Wait up to this long (milliseconds, cap 600000) for the render to finish and download it. Default 0: return at once. Waiting needs a key with mastering:read, otherwise the job is returned at once. The job keeps running if it is exceeded.

path.description: Absolute or relative local path to the audio file. Mutually exclusive with contentBase64.

preset.description: Preset to apply: the uuid of a saved preset, or builtin:<id> (builtin:balanced, ...). Mutually exclusive with settings.

settings.description: Inline settings (format version 1) instead of a saved preset. Mutually exclusive with preset.

modules.description: All eight modules are required: autoEq, lows, mids, highs, deEss, width, loudness, destruct.

enabled.description: False bypasses the module whatever its value.

value.description: Position of the module, within the range and on the step given by jj_mastering_capabilities.

normalize.description: Whether the render is normalised to the target loudness.

target.description: Loudness target: streaming, apple, deezer, podcast or club.

name: jj_master_audio
title: Master an audio file with a preset
